app.name: FFmpeg Utils
app.tagline: Convert, trim, edit and extract media streams
empty.intro: Load a source to open the workbench. The file stays untouched; every job writes a new output.
empty.step1: Load a video from disk or drop it in the source bay.
empty.step2: Choose a session: convert, trim, edit tracks or extract.
empty.step3: Run the job and inspect the verification report.
empty.formats: MKV / MP4 / MOV / AVI / TS / WEBM
dropsession.label: Ingest source
header.convertSubtitle: Resize and pad to the selected canvas without distorting the image.
header.trimSubtitle: Cut an interval without touching the original.
header.tracksSubtitle: Keep, remove or add audio and subtitle tracks without re-encoding the video.
header.extractSubtitle: Pull audio and subtitles out without re-encoding.
drop.title: Drop your video here
drop.hint: MKV, MP4, MOV, AVI, TS and more
tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.subtitle: Subtitle
tracks.noAudio: No audio track will be written.
tracks.noSubtitles: No subtitle track will be written.
tracks.noCompatible: No compatible tracks were found in this file.
convert.title: 1080p conversion
convert.subtitle: Scale and pad to 1920×1080, keeping the original aspect ratio.
convert.amfHint: Hardware encode with AMD AMF. Faster, tuned for this GPU.
convert.softwareHint: CPU encode with libx264. Slower, predictable output.
convert.keepVideoHint: Only available when the video already matches the target resolution.
convert.reencodeHint: Encode again with AMD AMF for a fresh 1080p file.
convert.fullHdNotice: This video already fills the 1080p canvas.
convert.noAmf: AMD AMF is unavailable. The conversion will use software encoding.
trim.title: Trim interval
trim.subtitle: Set a start and end point. The original file is never modified.
trim.fastHint: Stream copy: instant, but starts at the previous keyframe.
trim.preciseHint: Exact cut: re-encodes only the video with AMD AMF. Slower.
trim.softwareHint: Exact cut with software encoding. Slower than AMF.
trim.invalid: Check the start and end times.
extract.title: Extract audio and subtitles
extract.subtitle: Copy tracks without re-encoding, one file per track.
extract.noTracks: No audio tracks were found for this language.
extract.info: Audio keeps its codec; subtitles stay in their native format whenever possible.
extractDialog.title: Extract tracks
extractDialog.info: Select one or more tracks. Each one is written to its own file.
extractDialog.warning: Some subtitles may be converted to SRT or stored in a Matroska subtitle container.
